headline: Exodus April 7 2027
title: Exodus Release Date April 7 | Sci-Fi RPG | Gaming News
video_script: Exodus has a release date. The sci-fi action role playing game from Archetype Entertainment, launches on April seventh, twenty twenty seven, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC. The date was revealed in a trailer at Gamescom Opening Night Live in August. Will you pick it up on day one? Comment below!
description: Exodus from Archetype Entertainment launches April 7, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026. Sources: Game Informer, PCGamesN, RPG Site, GamingTrend.
